findings.remediation: Removed destructive drain consumption. Batch dispatch requires a non-destructive peek/dispose port, retains failed and trailing events, and disposes only after a successful P2 response write.
findings.integration_stop: P2 must publish lifecycle-fenced peek_host_events/dispose_host_event semantics.

findings.remediation: Validates Job, plan and Attempt command identities, hashes, epochs and timestamps before invoking any writer; malformed inputs have zero durable rows.
Never returns replayed=false without an atomic authority outcome; known replay is true and a potentially first concurrent result is null.
findings.integration_stop: P1 must return an atomic created/replayed disposition.

findings.remediation: Requires typed checkpoint/stream bindings and validates Workspace, Job, Step, source Attempt/epoch, checkpoint contract/hash, stream target, uniqueness and canonical order under the repository read gate.

Requires a side-effect-free PreparedHostRpcResult, binds validate_rpc_result to the exact request, then invokes its transaction commit callback and only afterward writes the P2 success ACK. Mismatches produce zero commit, ACK or disposition.
findings.integration_stop: Durable owner handlers must implement the prepared-result/commit transaction port.

findings.remediation: Attempt start requires a typed immutable AttemptStartBinding and validates its exact identity plus allocated epoch/receipt/result contract.
findings.integration_stop: P1 must return AttemptStartBinding atomically; P2 must supply/scrub one-shot secrets and reconcile by method, Attempt, allocated epoch and canonical payload hash.

finding_negatives: first handler failure retains the full batch
middle handler failure disposes only the successful prefix
empty RPC ID has no handler, ACK or disposition
concurrent create never returns an unproved replayed=false
request/result contract mismatch has no ACK or disposition
invalid epoch and secrets have zero Attempt-start port calls and rows
validation.diff_check: git diff --cached --check exit 0 on 12 owned paths
